verses.original: ה֚וֹי אֲרִיאֵ֣ל אֲרִיאֵ֔ל קִרְיַ֖ת חָנָ֣ה דָוִ֑ד סְפ֥וּ שָׁנָ֛ה עַל־ שָׁנָ֖ה חַגִּ֥ים יִנְקֹֽפוּ׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w ’ă·rî·’êl ’ă·rî·’êl qir·yaṯ ḥā·nāh ḏā·wiḏ sə·p̄ū šā·nāh ‘al- šā·nāh ḥag·gîm yin·qō·p̄ū
verses.literal: Woe to you O Ariel the city of Ariel where David . . . camped Year upon year let your festivals recur
verses.literalPt: AI de Ariel, Ariel, a cidade onde Davi acampou! Acrescentai ano a ano, e sucedam-se as festas.

verses.original: וַהֲצִיק֖וֹתִי לַֽאֲרִיאֵ֑ל וְהָיְתָ֤ה תַֽאֲנִיָּה֙ וַֽאֲנִיָּ֔ה וְהָ֥יְתָה לִּ֖י כַּאֲרִיאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wa·hă·ṣî·qō·w·ṯî la·’ă·rî·’êl wə·hā·yə·ṯāh ṯa·’ă·nî·yāh wa·’ă·nî·yāh wə·hā·yə·ṯāh lî ka·’ă·rî·’êl
verses.literal: And I will constrain Ariel and there will be mourning and lamentation she will be like an altar hearth before Me
verses.literalPt: Contudo porei a Ariel em aperto, e haverá pranto e tristeza; e ela será para mim como Ariel.

verses.original: וְחָנִ֥יתִי כַדּ֖וּר עָלָ֑יִךְ וְצַרְתִּ֤י עָלַ֙יִךְ֙ מֻצָּ֔ב וַהֲקִֽימֹתִ֥י עָלַ֖יִךְ מְצֻרֹֽת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḥā·nî·ṯî ḵad·dūr ‘ā·lā·yiḵ wə·ṣar·tî ‘ā·la·yiḵ muṣ·ṣāḇ wa·hă·qî·mō·ṯî ‘ā·la·yiḵ mə·ṣu·rōṯ
verses.literal: I will camp in a circle around you I will besiege you with towers and set up siege works against you
verses.literalPt: Porque te cercarei com o meu arraial, e te sitiarei com baluartes, e levantarei trincheiras contra ti.

verses.original: וְשָׁפַלְתְּ֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ תְּדַבֵּ֔רִי וּמֵֽעָפָ֖ר תִּשַּׁ֣ח אִמְרָתֵ֑ךְ וְֽ֠הָיָה כְּא֤וֹב מֵאֶ֙רֶץ֙ קוֹלֵ֔ךְ וּמֵעָפָ֖ר אִמְרָתֵ֥ךְ תְּצַפְצֵֽף׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·p̄alt mê·’e·reṣ tə·ḏab·bê·rî ū·mê·‘ā·p̄ār tiš·šaḥ ’im·rā·ṯêḵ wə·hā·yāh kə·’ō·wḇ mê·’e·reṣ qō·w·lêḵ ū·mê·‘ā·p̄ār ’im·rā·ṯêḵ tə·ṣap̄·ṣêp̄
verses.literal: You will be brought low you will speak from the ground and out of the dust your words will be muffled Your voice will be like a spirit from the ground your speech will whisper out of the dust
verses.literalPt: Então serás abatida, falarás de debaixo da terra, e a tua fala desde o pó sairá fraca, e será a tua voz debaixo da terra, como a de um que tem espírito familiar, e a tua fala assobiará desde o pó.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֛ה כְּאָבָ֥ק דַּ֖ק הֲמ֣וֹן זָרָ֑יִךְ וּכְמֹ֤ץ עֹבֵר֙ הֲמ֣וֹן עָֽרִיצִ֔ים וְהָיָ֖ה לְפֶ֥תַע פִּתְאֹֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh kə·’ā·ḇāq daq hă·mō·wn zā·rā·yiḵ ū·ḵə·mōṣ ‘ō·ḇêr hă·mō·wn ‘ā·rî·ṣîm wə·hā·yāh lə·p̄e·ṯa‘ piṯ·’ōm
verses.literal: But your many foes will be like fine dust the multitude of the ruthless . . . like blowing chaff Then suddenly in an instant
verses.literalPt: E a multidão dos teus inimigos será como o pó miúdo, e a multidão dos tiranos como a pragana que passa, e num momento repentino isso acontecerá.

verses.original: מֵעִ֨ם יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ תִּפָּקֵ֔ד בְּרַ֥עַם וּבְרַ֖עַשׁ וְק֣וֹל גָּד֑וֹל סוּפָה֙ וּסְעָרָ֔ה וְלַ֖הַב אֵ֥שׁ אוֹכֵלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: mê·‘im Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ tip·pā·qêḏ bə·ra·‘am ū·ḇə·ra·‘aš wə·qō·wl gā·ḏō·wl sū·p̄āh ū·sə·‘ā·rāh wə·la·haḇ ’êš ’ō·w·ḵê·lāh
verses.literal: you will be visited by the LORD of Hosts with thunder and earthquake and loud noise with windstorm and tempest and consuming flame of fire
verses.literalPt: Do SENHOR dos Exércitos serás visitada com trovões, e com terremotos, e grande ruído com tufão de vento, e tempestade, e labareda de fogo consumidor.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה כַּֽחֲלוֹם֙ חֲז֣וֹן לַ֔יְלָה הֲמוֹן֙ כָּל־ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם הַצֹּבְאִ֖ים עַל־ אֲרִיאֵ֑ל וְכָל־ צֹבֶ֙יהָ֙ וּמְצֹ֣דָתָ֔הּ וְהַמְּצִיקִ֖ים לָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ka·ḥă·lō·wm ḥă·zō·wn lay·lāh hă·mō·wn kāl- hag·gō·w·yim haṣ·ṣō·ḇə·’îm ‘al- ’ă·rî·’êl wə·ḵāl ṣō·ḇe·hā ū·mə·ṣō·ḏā·ṯāh wə·ham·mə·ṣî·qîm lāh
verses.literal: All the many nations going out to battle against Ariel even all who war against her laying siege and attacking her will be like a dream like a vision in the night
verses.literalPt: E como o sonho e uma visão de noite será a multidão de todas as nações que hão de pelejar contra Ariel, como também todos os que pelejarem contra ela e contra a sua fortaleza, e a puserem em aperto.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֡ה כַּאֲשֶׁר֩ יַחֲלֹ֨ם הָרָעֵ֜ב וְהִנֵּ֣ה אוֹכֵ֗ל וְהֵקִיץ֮ וְרֵיקָ֣ה נַפְשׁוֹ֒ וְכַאֲשֶׁ֨ר יַחֲלֹ֤ם הַצָּמֵא֙ וְהִנֵּ֣ה שֹׁתֶ֔ה וְהֵקִיץ֙ וְהִנֵּ֣ה עָיֵ֔ף וְנַפְשׁ֖וֹ שׁוֹקֵקָ֑ה כֵּ֣ן יִֽהְיֶ֗ה הֲמוֹן֙ כָּל־ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם הַצֹּבְאִ֖ים עַל־ הַ֥ר צִיּֽוֹן׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ka·’ă·šer ya·ḥă·lōm hā·rā·‘êḇ wə·hin·nêh ’ō·w·ḵêl wə·hê·qîṣ wə·rê·qāh nap̄·šōw wə·ḵa·’ă·šer ya·ḥă·lōm haṣ·ṣā·mê wə·hin·nêh šō·ṯeh wə·hê·qîṣ wə·hin·nêh ‘ā·yêp̄ wə·nap̄·šōw šō·w·qê·qāh kên yih·yeh hă·mō·wn kāl- hag·gō·w·yim haṣ·ṣō·ḇə·’îm ‘al- har ṣî·yō·wn
verses.literal: as when a hungry man . . . dreams he is eating then awakens still hungry . . . as when a thirsty man . . . dreams he is drinking then awakens . . . faint . . . and parched So will it be for all the many nations who go to battle against Mount Zion
verses.literalPt: Será também como o faminto que sonha, que está a comer, porém, acordando, sente-se vazio; ou como o sedento que sonha que está a beber, porém, acordando, eis que ainda desfalecido se acha, e a sua alma com sede; assim será toda a multidão das nações, que pelejarem contra o monte Sião.

verses.original: הִתְמַהְמְה֣וּ וּתְמָ֔הוּ הִשְׁתַּֽעַשְׁע֖וּ וָשֹׁ֑עוּ שָֽׁכְר֣וּ וְלֹא־ יַ֔יִן נָע֖וּ וְלֹ֥א שֵׁכָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: hiṯ·mah·mə·hū ū·ṯə·mā·hū hiš·ta·‘aš·‘ū wā·šō·‘ū šā·ḵə·rū wə·lō- ya·yin nā·‘ū wə·lō šê·ḵār
verses.literal: Stop and be astonished blind yourselves and be sightless be drunk but not with wine stagger but not from strong drink
verses.literalPt: Tardai, e maravilhai-vos, folgai, e clamai; bêbados estão, mas não de vinho, andam titubeando, mas não de bebida forte.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ נָסַ֨ךְ עֲלֵיכֶ֤ם יְהוָה֙ ר֣וּחַ תַּרְדֵּמָ֔ה וַיְעַצֵּ֖ם אֶת־ עֵֽינֵיכֶ֑ם אֶת־ הַנְּבִיאִ֛ים וְאֶת־ רָאשֵׁיכֶ֥ם הַחֹזִ֖ים כִּסָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî- nā·saḵ ‘ă·lê·ḵem Yah·weh rū·aḥ tar·dê·māh way·‘aṣ·ṣêm ’eṯ- ‘ê·nê·ḵem ’eṯ- han·nə·ḇî·’îm wə·’eṯ- rā·šê·ḵem ha·ḥō·zîm kis·sāh
verses.literal: For the LORD has poured out on you a spirit of deep sleep He has shut your eyes O prophets He has covered your heads O seers
verses.literalPt: Porque o SENHOR derramou sobre vós um espírito de profundo sono, e fechou os vossos olhos, vendou os profetas, e os vossos principais videntes.

verses.original: וַתְּהִ֨י לָכֶ֜ם חָז֣וּת הַכֹּ֗ל כְּדִבְרֵי֮ הַסֵּ֣פֶר הֶֽחָתוּם֒ אֲשֶֽׁר־ יִתְּנ֣וּ אֹת֗וֹ אֶל־ יוֹדֵ֥עַ הַסֵּפֶר לֵאמֹ֖ר קְרָ֣א נָא־ זֶ֑ה וְאָמַר֙ לֹ֣א אוּכַ֔ל כִּ֥י חָת֖וּם הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tə·hî lā·ḵem ḥā·zūṯ hak·kōl kə·ḏiḇ·rê has·sê·p̄er he·ḥā·ṯūm ’ă·šer- yit·tə·nū ’ō·ṯōw ’el- yō·w·ḏê·a‘ has·sē·p̄ɛr lê·mōr qə·rā nā- zeh wə·’ā·mar lō ’ū·ḵal kî ḥā·ṯūm hū
verses.literal: And the entire vision will be to you like the words sealed in a scroll If it is handed to someone to read . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . he will say I cannot . . . because it is sealed
verses.literalPt: Por isso toda a visão vos é como as palavras de um livro selado que se dá ao que sabe ler, dizendo: Lê isto, peço-te; e ele dirá: Não posso, porque está selado.

verses.original: וְנִתַּ֣ן הַסֵּ֗פֶר עַל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹֽא־ יָדַ֥ע סֵ֛פֶר לֵאמֹ֖ר קְרָ֣א נָא־ זֶ֑ה וְאָמַ֕ר לֹ֥א יָדַ֖עְתִּי סֵֽפֶר׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·nit·tan has·sê·p̄er ‘al ’ă·šer lō- yā·ḏa‘ sê·p̄er lê·mōr qə·rā nā- zeh wə·’ā·mar lō yā·ḏa‘·tî sê·p̄er
verses.literal: Or if the scroll is handed to one unable to read . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . he will say I cannot read . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Ou dá-se o livro ao que não sabe ler, dizendo: Lê isto, peço-te; e ele dirá: Não sei ler.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲדֹנָ֗י יַ֚עַן כִּ֤י נִגַּשׁ֙ הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה בְּפִ֤יו וּבִשְׂפָתָיו֙ כִּבְּד֔וּנִי וְלִבּ֖וֹ רִחַ֣ק מִמֶּ֑נִּי וַתְּהִ֤י יִרְאָתָם֙ אֹתִ֔י מִצְוַ֥ת אֲנָשִׁ֖ים מְלֻמָּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ă·ḏō·nāy ya·‘an kî nig·gaš hā·‘ām haz·zeh bə·p̄îw ū·ḇiś·p̄ā·ṯāw kib·bə·ḏū·nî wə·lib·bōw ri·ḥaq mim·men·nî wat·tə·hî yir·’ā·ṯām ’ō·ṯî miṣ·waṯ ’ă·nā·šîm mə·lum·mā·ḏāh
verses.literal: Therefore . . . the Lord said These people draw near to Me with their mouths and honor Me with their lips but their hearts are far from Me Their worship of Me is but rules taught by men
verses.literalPt: Porque o Senhor disse: Pois que este povo se aproxima de mim, e com a sua boca, e com os seus lábios me honra, mas o seu coração se afasta para longe de mim e o seu temor para comigo consiste só em mandamentos de homens, em que foi instruído;

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן הִנְנִ֥י יוֹסִ֛ף לְהַפְלִ֥יא אֶת־ הָֽעָם־ הַזֶּ֖ה הַפְלֵ֣א וָפֶ֑לֶא וְאָֽבְדָה֙ חָכְמַ֣ת חֲכָמָ֔יו וּבִינַ֥ת נְבֹנָ֖יו תִּסְתַּתָּֽר׃ס
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên hin·nî yō·w·sip̄ lə·hap̄·lî ’eṯ- hā·‘ām- haz·zeh hap̄·lê wā·p̄e·le wə·’ā·ḇə·ḏāh ḥā·ḵə·maṯ ḥă·ḵā·māw ū·ḇî·naṯ nə·ḇō·nāw tis·tat·tār
verses.literal: Therefore . . . I will again confound these people with wonder upon wonder The wisdom of the wise will vanish and the intelligence of the intelligent will be hidden
verses.literalPt: Portanto eis que continuarei a fazer uma obra maravilhosa no meio deste povo, uma obra maravilhosa e um assombro; porque a sabedoria dos seus sábios perecerá, e o entendimento dos seus prudentes se esconderá.

verses.original: ה֛וֹי הַמַּעֲמִיקִ֥ים מֵֽיהוָ֖ה לַסְתִּ֣ר עֵצָ֑ה וְהָיָ֤ה בְמַחְשָׁךְ֙ מַֽעֲשֵׂיהֶ֔ם וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ מִ֥י רֹאֵ֖נוּ וּמִ֥י יוֹדְעֵֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w ham·ma·‘ă·mî·qîm Yah·weh las·tir ‘ê·ṣāh wə·hā·yāh ḇə·maḥ·šāḵ ma·‘ă·śê·hem way·yō·mə·rū mî rō·’ê·nū ū·mî yō·wḏ·‘ê·nū
verses.literal: Woe to those who dig deep to hide their plans . . . from the LORD In darkness they do their works and say Who sees us and who will know
verses.literalPt: Ai dos que querem esconder profundamente o seu propósito do SENHOR, e fazem as suas obras às escuras, e dizem: Quem nos vê? E quem nos conhece?

verses.original: הַ֨פְכְּכֶ֔ם אִם־ כְּחֹ֥מֶר הַיֹּצֵ֖ר יֵֽחָשֵׁ֑ב כִּֽי־ יֹאמַ֨ר מַעֲשֶׂ֤ה לְעֹשֵׂ֙הוּ֙ לֹ֣א עָשָׂ֔נִי וְיֵ֛צֶר אָמַ֥ר לְיוֹצְר֖וֹ לֹ֥א הֵבִֽין׃
verses.transliteration: hap̄·kə·ḵem ’im- kə·ḥō·mer hay·yō·ṣêr yê·ḥā·šêḇ kî- yō·mar ma·‘ă·śeh lə·‘ō·śê·hū lō ‘ā·śā·nî wə·yê·ṣer ’ā·mar lə·yō·wṣ·rōw lō hê·ḇîn
verses.literal: You have turned things upside down as if the potter were regarded as clay Shall what is formed say to him who formed it He did not make me Can the pottery say of the potter He has no understanding
verses.literalPt: Vós tudo perverteis, como se o oleiro fosse igual ao barro, e a obra dissesse do seu artífice: Não me fez; e o vaso formado dissesse do seu oleiro: Nada sabe.

verses.original: הֲלוֹא־ עוֹד֙ מְעַ֣ט מִזְעָ֔ר וְשָׁ֥ב לְבָנ֖וֹן לַכַּרְמֶ֑ל וְהַכַּרְמֶ֖ל לַיַּ֥עַר יֵחָשֵֽׁב׃
verses.transliteration: hă·lō·w- ‘ō·wḏ mə·‘aṭ miz·‘ār wə·šāḇ lə·ḇā·nō·wn lak·kar·mel wə·hak·kar·mel lay·ya·‘ar yê·ḥā·šêḇ
verses.literal: In a very short time will not Lebanon become an orchard and the orchard seem like a forest
verses.literalPt: Porventura não se converterá o Líbano, num breve momento, em campo fértil? E o campo fértil não se reputará por um bosque?

verses.original: וְשָׁמְע֧וּ בַיּוֹם־ הַה֛וּא הַחֵרְשִׁ֖ים דִּבְרֵי־ סֵ֑פֶר וּמֵאֹ֣פֶל וּמֵחֹ֔שֶׁךְ עֵינֵ֥י עִוְרִ֖ים תִּרְאֶֽינָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·mə·‘ū ḇay·yō·wm- ha·hū ha·ḥê·rə·šîm diḇ·rê- sê·p̄er ū·mê·’ō·p̄el ū·mê·ḥō·šeḵ ‘ê·nê ‘iw·rîm tir·’e·nāh
verses.literal: On that day the deaf will hear the words of the scroll and out of the deep darkness the eyes of the blind will see
verses.literalPt: E naquele dia os surdos ouvirão as palavras do livro, e dentre a escuridão e dentre as trevas os olhos dos cegos as verão.

verses.original: וְיָסְפ֧וּ עֲנָוִ֛ים בַּֽיהוָ֖ה שִׂמְחָ֑ה וְאֶבְיוֹנֵ֣י אָדָ֔ם בִּקְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל יָגִֽילוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·sə·p̄ū ‘ă·nā·wîm Yah·weh śim·ḥāh wə·’eḇ·yō·w·nê ’ā·ḏām biq·ḏō·wōš yiś·rā·’êl yā·ḡî·lū
verses.literal: The humble will increase their joy in the LORD and the poor among men will rejoice in the Holy One of Israel
verses.literalPt: E os mansos terão gozo sobre gozo no SENHOR; e os necessitados entre os homens se alegrarão no Santo de Israel.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אָפֵ֥ס עָרִ֖יץ וְכָ֣לָה לֵ֑ץ וְנִכְרְת֖וּ כָּל־ שֹׁ֥קְדֵי אָֽוֶן׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ’ā·p̄ês ‘ā·rîṣ wə·ḵā·lāh lêṣ wə·niḵ·rə·ṯū kāl- šō·qə·ḏê ’ā·wen
verses.literal: For the ruthless will vanish the mockers will disappear and all who look for evil will be cut down
verses.literalPt: Porque o tirano é reduzido a nada, e se consome o escarnecedor, e todos os que se dão à iniqüidade são desarraigados;

verses.original: מַחֲטִיאֵ֤י אָדָם֙ בְּדָבָ֔ר וְלַמּוֹכִ֥יחַ בַּשַּׁ֖עַר יְקֹשׁ֑וּן וַיַּטּ֥וּ בַתֹּ֖הוּ צַדִּֽיק׃ס
verses.transliteration: ma·ḥă·ṭî·’ê ’ā·ḏām bə·ḏā·ḇār wə·lam·mō·w·ḵî·aḥ baš·ša·‘ar yə·qō·šūn way·yaṭ·ṭū ḇat·tō·hū ṣad·dîq
verses.literal: those who indict a man with a word who ensnare the mediator at the gate and who with false charges deprive the innocent of justice
verses.literalPt: Os que fazem culpado ao homem por uma palavra, e armam laços ao que repreende na porta, e os que sem motivo põem de parte o justo.

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ בֵּ֣ית יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֥ר פָּדָ֖ה אֶת־ אַבְרָהָ֑ם לֹֽא־ עַתָּ֤ה יֵבוֹשׁ֙ יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב וְלֹ֥א עַתָּ֖ה פָּנָ֥יו יֶחֱוָֽרוּ׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ’el- bêṯ ya·‘ă·qōḇ ’ă·šer pā·ḏāh ’eṯ- ’aḇ·rā·hām lō- ‘at·tāh yê·ḇō·wōš ya·‘ă·qōḇ wə·lō ‘at·tāh pā·nāw ye·ḥĕ·wā·rū
verses.literal: Therefore the LORD who redeemed Abraham says of the house of Jacob No longer will Jacob be ashamed and no more will his face grow pale
verses.literalPt: Portanto assim diz o SENHOR, que remiu a Abraão, acerca da casa de Jacó: Jacó não será agora envergonhado, nem agora se descorará a sua face.

verses.original: כִּ֣י בִ֠רְאֹתוֹ יְלָדָ֞יו מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יָדַ֛י בְּקִרְבּ֖וֹ יַקְדִּ֣ישֽׁוּ שְׁמִ֑י וְהִקְדִּ֙ישׁוּ֙ אֶת־ קְד֣וֹשׁ יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב וְאֶת־ אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל יַעֲרִֽיצוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḇir·’ō·ṯōw yə·lā·ḏāw ma·‘ă·śêh yā·ḏay bə·qir·bōw yaq·dî·šū šə·mî wə·hiq·dî·šū ’eṯ- qə·ḏō·wōš ya·‘ă·qōḇ wə·’eṯ- ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl ya·‘ă·rî·ṣū
verses.literal: For when he sees his children around him the work of My hands they will honor My name they will sanctify the Holy One of Jacob and they will stand in awe of the God of Israel
verses.literalPt: Mas quando ele vir seus filhos, obra das minhas mãos no meio dele, santificarão o meu nome; sim, santificarão ao Santo de Jacó, e temerão ao Deus de Israel.

verses.original: וְיָדְע֥וּ תֹֽעֵי־ ר֖וּחַ בִּינָ֑ה וְרוֹגְנִ֖ים יִלְמְדוּ־ לֶֽקַח׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·ḏə·‘ū ṯō·‘ê- rū·aḥ bî·nāh wə·rō·wḡ·nîm yil·mə·ḏū- le·qaḥ
verses.literal: Then the wayward in spirit will come to understanding and those who grumble will accept instruction
verses.literalPt: E os errados de espírito virão a ter entendimento, e os murmuradores aprenderão doutrina.
